stories.title: ChatGPT 奪回 55.5% 的網路流量佔有率，Gemini's 的短暫回歸逐漸黯淡 / ChatGPT claws back web traffic share to 55.5 percent as Gemini's brief comeback fades

sources.title: ChatGPT 奪回 55.5% 的網路流量佔有率，Gemini's 的短暫回歸逐漸黯淡 / ChatGPT claws back web traffic share to 55.5 percent as Gemini's brief comeback fades
sources.title_zh: ChatGPT 奪回 55.5% 的網路流量佔有率，Gemini's 的短暫回歸逐漸黯淡
sources.title_en: ChatGPT claws back web traffic share to 55.5 percent as Gemini's brief comeback fades
sources.title_original: ChatGPT claws back web traffic share to 55.5 percent as Gemini's brief comeback fades
sources.summary: ChatGPT has pushed its share of AI chatbot website traffic back up to 55.5 percent, according to Similarweb. Year-over-year, though, its lead shrank sharply from 73.3 percent as Gemini doubled its share and Claude grew nearly fivefold. Mobile apps and desktop clients aren't included. The article ChatGPT claws back web traffic share to 55.5 percent as Gemini's brief comeback fades appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 根據 Similarweb 的數據，ChatGPT 已將其 AI 聊天機器人網站流量佔有率推回 55.5%。不過，與去年同期相比，其領先優勢從 73.3% 大幅縮水，因為 Gemini 的佔有率倍增，而 Claude 則成長了近五倍。行動應用程式和桌面客戶端不包含在內。本文 ChatGPT claws back web traffic share to 55.5 percent as Gemini's brief comeback fades 最初發布於 The Decoder。

sources.title_en: Anthropic reportedly signs $517 billion in compute deals after Dario Amodei warned rivals about reckless risk
sources.title_original: Anthropic reportedly signs $517 billion in compute deals after Dario Amodei warned rivals about reckless risk
sources.summary: Anthropic signed compute contracts worth up to $517 billion in eleven months but still trails OpenAI's $750 billion plan through 2030. In early 2026, CEO Dario Amodei warned against investing too fast. Now Anthropic is racing to catch up, while Sam Altman warns about "unsustainable silliness" in the compute buildout, especially from neo-cloud providers. The article Anthropic reportedly signs $517 billion in compute deals after Dario Amodei warned rivals about reckless risk appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic 在 11 個月內簽署了高達 5,170 億美元的運算合約，但其 2030 年前的規模仍落後於 OpenAI's 的 7,500 億美元計畫。2026 年初，執行長 Dario Amodei 曾警告不要投資過快。現在 Anthropic 正急起直追，而 Sam Altman 則警告運算基礎設施建設中存在「不可持續的荒謬現象」，特別是來自新雲端服務供應商的建設。這篇題為〈Anthropic reportedly signs $517 billion in compute deals after Dario Amodei warned rivals about reckless risk〉的文章最先出現在 The Decoder。

sources.summary: OpenAI reports that AI agents in its own research already handle 3.1 workdays for every human workday, and it says it has reached its goal of an "automated research intern." But chief scientist Pachocki warns that no lab has a good enough grip on alignment and monitoring to keep scaling at maximum speed. The article OpenAI reports AI "research interns" and warns about its own pace at the same time appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 報導稱，其自身研究中的 AI 代理在每個人類工作日中已經能處理相當於 3.1 個工作日的工作量，並表示它已達成「自動化研究實習生」的目標。但首席科學家 Pachocki 警告說，沒有任何實驗室能對齊與監控有夠好的掌握，以維持最大速度擴展。相關文章 OpenAI 報導了 AI「研究實習生」並同時對自身步調提出警告，最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.title_original: Qwen-Drive 1.0 tells you why it brakes, just don't expect the explanation to match the maneuver
sources.summary: Alibaba's research arm has released Qwen-Drive 1.0, an AI model that handles environmental perception, traffic Q&A, and route planning in one system. The researchers show that text-image models don't automatically understand three-dimensional space. Spatial awareness has to be trained on purpose. The goal is a single model that runs both the cockpit and the driving system. The article Qwen-Drive 1.0 tells you why it brakes, just don't expect the explanation to match the maneuver appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 阿里巴巴的 研究部門已發布 Qwen-Drive 1.0，這是一個在單一系統中處理環境感知、交通問答與路徑規劃的 AI 模型。研究人員指出，文字-圖片模型無法自動理解三維空間，空間意識必須透過專門訓練來獲得。其目標是打造一個能同時運行智慧座艙與駕駛系統的單一模型。這篇題為〈Qwen-Drive 1.0 tells you why it brakes, just don't expect the explanation to match the maneuver〉的文章最先出現在 The Decoder。

stories.title: AI 設計的藥物在早期試驗中似乎能倒轉人體的生物時鐘 / AI-designed drug appears to turn back the body's biological clock in early trial

sources.title: AI 設計的藥物在早期試驗中似乎能倒轉人體的生物時鐘 / AI-designed drug appears to turn back the body's biological clock in early trial
sources.title_zh: AI 設計的藥物在早期試驗中似乎能倒轉人體的生物時鐘
sources.title_en: AI-designed drug appears to turn back the body's biological clock in early trial
sources.title_original: AI-designed drug appears to turn back the body's biological clock in early trial
sources.summary: A study in Nature Biotechnology suggests that rentosertib, a drug designed with AI by Insilico Medicine, may reverse markers of biological aging. Six independent aging clocks predicted that treated patients were biologically up to six years younger than the placebo group. The trial covered just 42 patients and the drug hasn't been tested in healthy people yet. The article AI-designed drug appears to turn back the body's biological clock in early trial appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 發表於《自然生物科技》（Nature Biotechnology）的一項研究表明，由 Insilico Medicine 利用 AI 設計的藥物 rentosertib 可能有助於逆轉生物老化指標。六個獨立的老年鐘（aging clocks）預測，接受治療的患者在生物學上比安慰劑組年輕最多六年。該試驗僅涵蓋 42 名患者，且該藥物尚未在健康人群中進行測試。本文 AI-designed drug appears to turn back the body's biological clock in early trial 最初發布於 The Decoder。

The trial covered just 42 patients and the drug hasn't been tested in healthy people yet. The article AI-designed drug appears to turn back the body's biological clock in early trial appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 發表於《自然生物科技》（Nature Biotechnology）的一項研究表明，由 Insilico Medicine 利用 AI 設計的藥物 rentosertib 可能有助於逆轉生物老化指標。六個獨立的老年鐘（aging clocks）預測，接受治療的患者在生物學上比安慰劑組年輕最多六年。該試驗僅涵蓋 42 名患者，且該藥物尚未在健康人群中進行測試。本文 AI-designed drug appears to turn back the body's biological clock in early trial 最初發布於 The Decoder。

sources.summary: Swiss banking giant UBS is making AI skills a required qualification from 2027 for graduates and interns in Global Banking and Markets, with applicants having to show in interviews how they use AI to improve outcomes and efficiency. Santander is already looking for advanced AI users too, while Morgan Stanley predicts more than 200,000 banking jobs in Europe will disappear within five years. The article At UBS, AI skills are now a condition for landing a job appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 瑞士銀行巨頭瑞銀（UBS）將 AI 技能列為 2027 年起全球銀行與市場部門畢業生和實習生的必備資格，申請人必須在面試中展示他們如何利用 AI 來改善成果與效率。桑坦德銀行（Santander）也已經在尋找具備進階 AI 能力的使用者，而摩根士丹利（Morgan Stanley）則預測，五年內歐洲將有超過 20 萬個銀行職位消失。「在瑞銀，AI 技能現在是獲得工作的條件」一文最先發布於 The Decoder。

stories.title: Reducto Releases r-1: A Single Pass Document Parsing Model That Cuts Errors 20% at 1 Cent Per Page

sources.title: Reducto Releases r-1: A Single Pass Document Parsing Model That Cuts Errors 20% at 1 Cent Per Page
sources.title_en: Reducto Releases r-1: A Single Pass Document Parsing Model That Cuts Errors 20% at 1 Cent Per Page
sources.title_original: Reducto Releases r-1: A Single Pass Document Parsing Model That Cuts Errors 20% at 1 Cent Per Page
sources.summary: We look at r-1, the document parsing model Reducto released on September 1, 2026. We walk through how it folds OCR, layout detection, tables, formatting and grounding into one full page pass, replacing the multi stage agentic pipeline it ships alongside. We break down the two numbers that matter for a migration decision: a reported 20% error reduction and a flat 1 cent per page rate against the legacy 3 to 6 cents. The post Reducto Releases r-1: A Single Pass Document Parsing Model That Cuts Errors 20% at 1 Cent Per Page appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: 我們來看看 Reducto 於 2026 年 9 月 1 日發布的文件解析模型 r-1。我們將介紹它如何將 OCR、版面偵測、表格、格式化和定位（grounding）整合到單一的整頁處理流程中，以取代其隨附的多階段代理式（agentic）管線。我們詳細分析了做出遷移決策時最重要的兩個數字：據報導錯誤率降低了 20%，以及每頁固定 1 美分的費率（相較於舊版的每頁 3 到 6 美分）。這篇文章 Reducto Releases r-1: A Single Pass Document Parsing Model That Cuts Errors 20% at 1 Cent Per Page 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

sources.title_original: HiddenLayer獲得1億美元B輪融資，擴大AI代理執行階段安全防護
sources.summary: AI資安業者HiddenLayer宣佈完成1億美元B輪融資，將運用這筆資金持續擴充AI安全平臺，並投入工程、研究及業務拓展。 HiddenLayer既有產品涵蓋生成式AI、預測式AI與AI代理，提供資產探索、供應鏈安全、攻擊模擬及執行階段防護等功能。今年則進一步強化AI代理實際執行任務時的安全控管。

stories.title: Upwind傳獲3億美元新融資，估值升至38億美元並擴大AI安全佈局

sources.title: Upwind傳獲3億美元新融資，估值升至38億美元並擴大AI安全佈局
sources.title_zh: Upwind傳獲3億美元新融資，估值升至38億美元並擴大AI安全佈局
sources.title_original: Upwind傳獲3億美元新融資，估值升至38億美元並擴大AI安全佈局
sources.summary: 雲端資安業者Upwind今年1月完成2.5億美元融資後，相隔不到8個月再傳取得約3億美元新資金，估值由約15億美元升至約38億美元。相關訊息由CTech、SiliconANGLE等媒體報導，但Upwind目前尚未正式公佈此次融資與估值變動。

stories.title: 解決企業AI導入兩難，中華資安推出自研產品AI Archway，內建市場少見的可逆式脫敏機制

sources.title: 解決企業AI導入兩難，中華資安推出自研產品AI Archway，內建市場少見的可逆式脫敏機制
sources.title_zh: 解決企業AI導入兩難，中華資安推出自研產品AI Archway，內建市場少見的可逆式脫敏機制
sources.title_original: 解決企業AI導入兩難，中華資安推出自研產品AI Archway，內建市場少見的可逆式脫敏機制
sources.summary: 隨著生成式AI匯入企業的速度加快，機敏資料外洩的防護與影子AI的治理已成為企業與資安業者共同的課題。除了國際科技與資安大廠積極佈局AI Security，這幾年來，臺灣陸續有業者投入相關產品發展，中華資安國際也是其中之一，今年上半年正式進軍這塊市場，7月正式推出名為「AI安檢通道（AI Archway）」的產品。

stories.title: OpenBMB 發布 MiniCPM5-2B：一款 25.2 億參數的密集型模型，在 34 個基準測試中平均得分 53.9，專為在裝置上運行而打造 / OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device

sources.title: OpenBMB 發布 MiniCPM5-2B：一款 25.2 億參數的密集型模型，在 34 個基準測試中平均得分 53.9，專為在裝置上運行而打造 / OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device
sources.title_zh: OpenBMB 發布 MiniCPM5-2B：一款 25.2 億參數的密集型模型，在 34 個基準測試中平均得分 53.9，專為在裝置上運行而打造
sources.title_en: OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device
sources.title_original: OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device
sources.summary: OpenBMB has released MiniCPM5-2B, a dense causal language model with 2,516,756,480 parameters and a native 131,072 token context. It averages 53.9 across the 34 benchmarks in its model card, ahead of Qwen3.5-4B at 51.1, with its clearest leads in tool use, coding agents and long-context retrieval. Post-training pairs 400B tokens of deep-thinking SFT with RL teachers and on-policy distillation that merges 16 expert models into one checkpoint. The weights ship under Apache 2.0 alongside the pre-training, SFT and RL datasets and the intermediate Base, Midtrain and SFT-only checkpoints. GGUF builds start at 1.56 GB, and the standard LlamaForCausalLM architecture loads in vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, Ollama and MLX without a model-code fork. The post OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: OpenBMB 發布了 MiniCPM5-2B，這是一個擁有 2,516,756,480 個參數以及原生 131,072 個 Token 內容視窗的密集型因果語言模型。在其模型卡片的 34 個基準測試中，它的平均得分達到 53.9，領先於 Qwen3.5-4B 的 51.1，其中在工具使用、編碼代理（coding agents）和長文本檢索方面的優勢最為明顯。後訓練（post-training）將 4000 億（400B）個 Token 的深度思考 SFT 與 RL 教師模型相結合，並透過線上策略蒸餾（on-policy distillation）將 16 個專家模型合併為一個檢查點。此權重採用 Apache 2.0 授權發布，同時提供的還有預訓練、SFT 與 RL 資料集，以及中繼的 Base、Midtrain 和 SFT-only 檢查點。GGUF 建置版本大小從 1.56 GB 起跳，且標準的 LlamaForCausalLM 架構可在 vLLM、SGLang、llama.cpp、Ollama 和 MLX 中載入，無需進行模型程式碼分支。這篇 OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.title_en: OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device
items.title_original: OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device
items.summary: OpenBMB has released MiniCPM5-2B, a dense causal language model with 2,516,756,480 parameters and a native 131,072 token context. It averages 53.9 across the 34 benchmarks in its model card, ahead of Qwen3.5-4B at 51.1, with its clearest leads in tool use, coding agents and long-context retrieval. Post-training pairs 400B tokens of deep-thinking SFT with RL teachers and on-policy distillation that merges 16 expert models into one checkpoint. The weights ship under Apache 2.0 alongside the pre-training, SFT and RL datasets and the intermediate Base, Midtrain and SFT-only checkpoints. GGUF builds start at 1.56 GB, and the standard LlamaForCausalLM architecture loads in vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, Ollama and MLX without a model-code fork. The post OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: OpenBMB 發布了 MiniCPM5-2B，這是一個擁有 2,516,756,480 個參數以及原生 131,072 個 Token 內容視窗的密集型因果語言模型。在其模型卡片的 34 個基準測試中，它的平均得分達到 53.9，領先於 Qwen3.5-4B 的 51.1，其中在工具使用、編碼代理（coding agents）和長文本檢索方面的優勢最為明顯。後訓練（post-training）將 4000 億（400B）個 Token 的深度思考 SFT 與 RL 教師模型相結合，並透過線上策略蒸餾（on-policy distillation）將 16 個專家模型合併為一個檢查點。此權重採用 Apache 2.0 授權發布，同時提供的還有預訓練、SFT 與 RL 資料集，以及中繼的 Base、Midtrain 和 SFT-only 檢查點。GGUF 建置版本大小從 1.56 GB 起跳，且標準的 LlamaForCausalLM 架構可在 vLLM、SGLang、llama.cpp、Ollama 和 MLX 中載入，無需進行模型程式碼分支。這篇 OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。
